description: Decommission a legacy application that is being replaced by a new service. Must: identify all dependencies (upstream callers, downstream APIs, databases), notify all teams depending on the application, set up traffic redirect to replacement service, handle in-flight transactions and billing reconciliation, export and archive historical data, revoke access credentials, and shut down infrastructure. Risk factors: missed upstream caller causing 500 errors, billing/refund handling for active subscriptions, data archive incomplete. Tools available: nginx, terraform, aws CLI, psql, Slack.
